publishers.evidence: API supports location/resource IDs, review ID, original source URL, 1–5 overall rating, moderation status, and timestamps. Approved review results can be paginated and updated by last_modified. Filter resource_id for care service, not the multi-service property_id. No published full aggregate count/average was established by the technical reference. The authorized full window should be reconciled against a publisher count; a derived mean should not substitute for a published aggregate.

recommendedTest: Send only public branch names, physical address+suite and HP IDs in a coverage request. Ask for a no-lead-sharing, read-only sample for the 21 near-threshold offices before purchase. Require total approved client/family count and average, source-native IDs and upstream families, freshness/withdrawals and explicit caching/display/derived-score rights; require no PII and drop response author email. Report returned branch matches, distinct eligible new families, and incremental scores versus today's corpus before budgeting.
